title: What the week leaves behind
governingQuestion: What survives, who can reuse it, and what never entered the record?
editorialHook: What disappears from the archive becomes harder to argue with.
longformOutline: Follow schedule, film, interface, and measurement record into four different preservation and reuse regimes.

accessibilityPlan: Publish transcript/captions for time media; alt text or explicit designed-absence label; keyboard path for the interactive; no status conveyed by color alone.

status: evidence-backed production package; interviews and unresolved future reporting remain open

finishedLongform.headline: What the week leaves behind
finishedLongform.opening: Fashion Week disappears by design. The venue returns to another use; the schedule changes; links decay; platforms reorder. What remains becomes the evidence from which future histories are made.
sections: Schedules, films, museum records and web archives preserve different fragments under different rules.
A retained event page can be citable while its images remain unavailable for reuse.
Environmental accountability requires a boundary, baseline, method, verifier and season—not an unqualified sustainability label.
No complete future event-level measurement system cleared this edition’s threshold.
finishedLongform.closing: Put a claim through the Claims Fitting Room before repeating it.
